groups.summary: Micro-toppings, thin-build, stampable and vertical overlay bag mixes.
groups.intro: Decorative concrete overlays come in single component and dual component mix designs. Here in Texas we deal with very hot and humid temperatures, so most contractors prefer a single component overlay since it takes fewer steps, and a retarder can add working time. We offer four kinds of overlay products: micro-toppings, thin-build, stampable and vertical.

groups.title: Austin Stone
groups.summary: An overlay system that turns worn concrete into hand-carved surfaces that look like natural stone.
groups.intro: Austin Stone Overlay turns your worn concrete into beautiful, hand-carved surfaces that look like natural stone, without the tearout. It is perfect for patios, pool decks, driveways, walkways and even garage floors. We don't offer installation ourselves, but we can connect you with a certified contractor trained in the Austin Stone overlay system. Contact us for recommendations in your area.

services.title: Installation Steps
services.text: How Austin Stone goes down.
points: Clean the surface of dirt, dust, paint, sealers, form releases, curing agents, grease and oil
Apply AS Bond Primer, undiluted, over a saturated substrate
Place the mixed overlay, screed with a gauge rake and smooth with a Fresno or hand trowel
Hand-carve textures and grout line patterns
Apply color
Seal

services.title: RESIST System
services.text: A three-part exterior system of flexible epoxy, Armorstone basalt aggregate and a protective top coat that turns worn, structurally sound concrete into a textured, slip-resistant surface without tearout. Every component is in stock at SCP.
points: Prep the surface
Apply RESIST Epoxy at 150 sq. ft. per gallon
Broadcast Armorstone aggregate into the wet epoxy
Remove loose aggregate
Finish with RESIST Top Coat

about.title: A Houston supply center for decorative concrete
text: Stamped Concrete Products is a Houston based decorative concrete supply center, offering a wide variety of colorants, overlays and tools for decorative concrete floors, walls, countertops and more.

No matter what your project needs are, the team at SCP has the industry's best products and tools available, from brands such as SureCrete, Blender, TK Products, Ameripolish, Spray-Lock and Smith Paints.
Need training? The SCP team is here to help, with hands-on demonstrations, system training and project specific training.

faqs.a: Austin Stone is a hand-carved concrete overlay system designed to mimic the look of natural stone. It's applied over existing concrete surfaces like patios, pool decks or driveways and then custom-colored and sealed.

faqs.q: How long does a hand-carved stone overlay last?
faqs.a: When professionally installed and properly maintained, Austin Stone overlays can last 15 to 20 years or more.

faqs.q: Does Austin Stone require a lot of maintenance?
faqs.a: Not at all. Austin Stone only requires periodic cleaning and resealing every few years to keep it looking fresh and protected.
We don't offer installation services ourselves, but we can connect you with a certified contractor trained in the Austin Stone overlay system. Contact us for recommendations in your area.

faqs.q: Can RESIST go over existing concrete?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as the concrete is structurally sound and properly prepared. Surface prep is the most important step in the system.
The Armorstone aggregate creates texture for traction. Final slip resistance depends on how the aggregate is broadcast and the top coat is applied, which is why training matters.

faqs.q: Is RESIST only for residential work?
faqs.a: Not at all. It works on homes and commercial entrances, walkways, retail, hospitality and other exterior surfaces.

faqs.q: Do I need training to install RESIST?
faqs.a: It's strongly recommended. SCP offers hands-on training in English and Spanish.

faqs.q: What does Blender Group specialize in?
faqs.a: Blender Group specializes in decorative concrete systems like stamped overlays, microcement and sealers, and industrial-grade solutions such as densifiers, grouts and self-leveling mortars.

faqs.q: Who are Blender products designed for?
faqs.a: Blender products are used by contractors, architects, developers, facility managers and distributors in commercial and residential construction.

faqs.q: Are BGA products tested for durability and compliance?
faqs.a: Blender says all its products are lab-tested and designed to meet or exceed industry standards for abrasion resistance, bonding strength and environmental safety.

faqs.q: How many times can I reuse GlobMarble stamps and molds?
faqs.a: GlobMarble polyurethane molds are designed to be reused up to 2,000 times when properly maintained, and their polyurethane concrete stamps are proven to withstand more than 100,000 impressions.

facts.heading: ¿Hablas Español? Aprende El Sistema RESIST
items: Capacitación práctica en español: preparación de la superficie, aplicación del epóxico, agregado Armorstone y capa protectora final.

¿Se puede instalar RESIST sobre concreto existente? Sí, siempre que el concreto esté estructuralmente sólido y correctamente preparado. La preparación de la superficie es el paso más importante del sistema.

¿RESIST es resbaloso cuando está mojado? No. El agregado Armorstone crea textura para proporcionar tracción. La resistencia final al deslizamiento depende de cómo se aplique el agregado y la capa protectora, por eso la capacitación es importante.
¿RESIST es solamente para proyectos residenciales? No. RESIST puede utilizarse en viviendas y en superficies comerciales como entradas, banquetas, áreas comerciales y espacios de hospitalidad.
¿Necesito capacitación para instalar RESIST? Se recomienda ampliamente. SCP ofrece capacitación práctica en inglés y español.
